item.title: Heartbreak for EU in SJS final
item.description: The East Union Lancers’ quest for a second Sac-Joaquin Section title ended in heartbreak Saturday night at Sacramento City College in a hard-fought 1-0 loss to defending champion Liberty Ranch of Galt in the Division IV final.

item.title: ROUNDUP: Manteca softball, Ripon tennis roll to non-league wins
item.description: Riley Ward pitched a mercy-shortened one-hitter on Monday, and Maleiah Garza hit a grand slam to highlight Manteca’s 10-0 non-league softball win at Atwater.

item.title: BASKETBALL: ‘New-look Lancers’ hosting semifinal doubleheader tonight
item.description: A 1979 graduate of East Union, where he was a multi-sport standout, Jim Agostini celebrates all the successes of his alma mater. The school’s longtime girls basketball coach has had a hand in much of it.

item.title: A double boomerang? Trump’s ‘Texas Hold ‘Em’ mid- term ploy & Newsom’s own responding bean ball pitch
item.description: Democrats might indeed pick up five California congressional seats in November thanks to Proposition 50 — Gov. Gavin Newsom’s slice and dice response to Trump’s playing Texas Hold ‘Em when it comes to redistricting for the 2026 midterms. But it’ll be a fleeting victory.

item.title: Manteca demolishes pair of homes gutted by fire on Willow Ave. in May
item.description: Crews on Monday started demolishing two houses in the 100 block of South Willow Avenue that were gutted by a fire nine months ago.

item.title: Del Webb group raises $3,600+ for Without Permission
item.description: The Pickleball Club of the Woodbridge by Del Webb community in Manteca organized a fundraiser dance on Friday benefitting Without Permission.

item.title: BREITENBUCHER IS SEEKING 3RD MANTECA COUNCIL TERM
item.description: No other elected Manteca leader has had as an intense of a hands-on approach to addressing the city’s most daunting challenge — homelessness — than Dave Breitenbucher.

item.title: New school bus access in works for MUSD yard
item.description: The bus access to the Manteca Unified School District office complex may be moved further north to address traffic conflicts at the Airport Way and Louise Avenue intersection.

item.title: Manteca will start work on new solid rate study for implementation in ‘28
item.description: Manteca will start work on a study this year to address new solid rate hikes that will go into effect Jan. 1, 2028.

item.title: MANTECA POLICE GOING TO THE BRINC (DRONES)
item.description: There is one key component the new $92 million Manteca Police headquarters breaking ground tentatively in August will have to enhance public safety. It’s a real time crime center.
